findings.evidence: a11y Rule: 'every control has a non-empty accessible name ... every action works by keyboard; WCAG AA contrast in every theme' restates WCAG basics the model already knows
findings.fix: Cut the a11y Rule to the non-obvious fail lines (24x24 px not 44, non-text 3:1 on input borders and focus rings, SC 2.5.3 visible-word match) and drop the generic name/keyboard/AA restatement

findings.evidence: Gotcha: '`fetch` resolves on 404 and 500: only a `response.ok` check ... reaches the error branch' is widely known; the states Trap at line 85 already points at it
findings.fix: Keep one short mention, in the states Trap, and remove the duplicate from Gotchas so each line adds something new

findings.evidence: 'Route: always steps 1 and 2; then build or fix → step 3; review, verdict or a diagnostic question → step 4; review and fix → step 4, then step 3; finish every edit with step 5.' The Process workflow is squeezed into one dense routing line on top of a Tool-style rule catalogue, so the pattern is a hybrid with no clear phase checkpoints
findings.fix: Turn the route into a three-branch decision list (Build/fix, Review, Review+fix), each listing its steps and its exit artifact (hand-over or table), so the Process pattern reads at a glance

findings.evidence: The NEVER list has four items, three of them about evidence honesty; build-time landmines (e.g. stripping MUI's focus ring with outline: none in sx, hiding a row action behind hover) live only in Traps
findings.fix: Add one or two build-time NEVER items with their reason, e.g. 'NEVER set outline: none without a :focus-visible replacement: keyboard users lose their position'

findings.evidence: Each rule ends with an ungated 'Detail: `references/rules/loading.md`'; the loading condition only appears at the bottom in ## References (line 197)
findings.fix: Change each pointer to a gated one, e.g. 'Detail (load only when writing this fix or deciding an exception): references/rules/loading.md'

findings.evidence: 'Render (below) what the change can affect: a layout change at all four widths, a color change in every shipped theme.' This makes a four-width Playwright run the default for every build step, even small edits
findings.fix: Make rendering the default only for layout or theme changes to a full screen, and state the cheap fallback for small component edits: list the gap under 'unverified' instead of spinning up a dev server

findings.evidence: 26 queries split 15 should-trigger and 11 should-not-trigger; the five lowercase positives at the end are close paraphrases of the description's quoted triggers ('review this page', 'make this look polished')
findings.fix: Rebalance to about 10 and 10, and swap the paraphrased positives for queries that need the skill without echoing the description (e.g. 'users on iPhone say the Save button disappears on the profile screen')

findings.evidence: Step 3 applies to 'any request to write or fix UI that does not ask for a review or verdict', but the route at line 12 sends 'review and fix → step 4, then step 3'. Followed literally, a review-and-fix request is shut out of step 3
findings.fix: Reword step 3's scope to 'Build or fix (a build or fix request, or the fix half of review-and-fix after step 4)'
